title: Build your first project
description: Name a project, add a server and its settings, then check and export it.
outcomes: Start a project and add an inventory
Share settings across a group with group vars
Read the live preview, Checks and Architecture
recap: A project starts from a name; settings can change later.
An inventory lists servers and sorts them into groups.
Group vars hold settings every server in a group shares.
Checks, Architecture and Export are one click away.

steps.intro: Let's build a small project from scratch. Sit back: I'll drive and explain as I go. Pause whenever you want to take over.
steps.name: Every project starts with a name. That's all kikx needs to begin.
steps.path: An empty project shows the usual path: list your servers, configure them, then deploy.
steps.inventory: First, the inventory: the servers kikx will set up.
steps.hostGroup: and a group. Groups let one play target many servers at once.
steps.preview: The files render live as you type. This is exactly what lands in your repo.
steps.add: Add the inventory to the project.
steps.groupVars: Next, settings shared by that group, called group vars.
steps.varKey: then add a setting: a key and its value.
steps.checklist: The checklist ticks itself off as you go and shows what comes next.
steps.checks: Checks looks across components for mistakes: unknown groups, duplicate hosts, missing roles.
steps.export: When you're ready, Export gives you plain files, a preset to reopen later, or the CLI command.
steps.done: That's the whole loop: describe, preview, check, export. Look around this demo project, or go back to yours.
